title: ScopeCsvRow
description: Schema for one row of scope.csv, as read by recon_engine.scope.ScopeEngine._load_rules_from_csv. Each row is one allow/exclude rule.

kind.description: cidr: value is a CIDR block (e.g. 127.0.0.0/8). hostname: value is an exact hostname. port: value is transport/range (e.g. tcp/1-9000).

value.description: The rule value, format depends on kind. See examples: '127.0.0.0/8' (cidr), 'target.invalid' (hostname), 'tcp/1-9000' (port).

direction.description: IN rows are loaded as allow rules. OUT rows (e.g. the explicit loopback decoy) are excluded entirely -- never added to the allow-list, and the engine's hard-coded loopback guard (recon_engine.scope.LoopbackGuard) independently blocks anything outside 127.0.0.0/8 regardless of this column.
